photoMethod: Original user-supplied photographs, with high-quality JPEG encoding only. Full image proportions are retained in the PDF; no faces, scenes or details are regenerated.
reviewMethod: Visible message text transcribed from attachments 9-14. Emoji and chat interface text are omitted. Overlapping screenshots are deduplicated. Printed excerpts are contiguous passages from the transcriptions, with punctuation and initial capitalization normalized only. No missing text, names or ratings are inferred. Unnamed messages are attributed only to the group.

reviews.sourceNote: The sender name is outside the screenshot. The last paragraph continues below the visible area; its incomplete final sentence is not used.
reviews.transcription:
Honestly, this was my first time doing something like this, and I did not have much expectations, rather I had some pressure because I wanted you all to have the best trip experience.

But little did I know that you all are so much fun that I did not have to care about a lot of things that much.

Jaha dekhri hu vaha maze he maze chal rhe hai. Sab itne fun,itne adjusting,mastikhor ki bhai there was not even one dull moment in these three days.

And trust me when I say this, I felt like I've known you guys forever. That instant connection I felt with each one of you really means everything to me.
reviews.excerpt: I felt like I've known you guys forever. That instant connection I felt with each one of you really means everything to me.
